title: Why AppLovin Jumped 31%: 5 Big Stock Moves, Ranked #shorts
description: AppLovin jumped 31% on Thursday after beating third quarter estimates. Here are five big stock moves from Thursday and Friday premarket, counted down.

beats.say: AppLovin jumped thirty one percent on Thursday. Five big moves, counted down. Three of them fell.

visual.label: Thursday close: AppLovin
visual.question: AppLovin led five big moves. Three fell.

beats.say: Number five. AMD fell seventeen point three percent, as investors sold chip stocks after the midterm elections.

visual.reason: Investors sold chip stocks after the midterms

beats.say: Number four. Micron fell seventeen point five percent, on worries about slower AI spending.
Number three. Cloudflare is up nineteen point six percent premarket so far, as revenue grew thirty nine percent.
Number two. DraftKings is down about twenty six percent premarket so far, after cutting its profit forecast on heavy spending for its new prediction product.

visual.reason: Cut profit forecast on new product spending

beats.say: And number one, AppLovin, up thirty one percent, after beating third quarter estimates and raising its outlook.

visual.reason: Beat Q3 estimates and raised its outlook

beats.say: Company results moved three of these stocks. A chip selloff moved two. And that's why
